blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon’s acting capacity was questioned during his department’s budget hearing at the Senate on Friday. This refers to the expiration of his one-year term limit and absence of a reappointment from the president. Sen. Imee Marcos grilled Dizon, asking about the status of his appointment, citing the Administrative Code, which states that temporary designations in an acting capacity must not exceed one year. “You were appointed as acting secretary of Public Works on September 1, 2025.
